data.name: Aadab
data.gender_notes: Aadab is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘A-D-B’, meaning ‘to return’, ‘to give’, or ‘to treat with kindness and respect’. In Islamic culture, Aadab represents the virtues of respect, courtesy, and honor, reflecting the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and the Quran. The name Aadab carries the meaning “Respect, Courtesy, Honor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aadab usually hope their child will grow to embody respect, courtesy, honor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of respect and courtesy towards others, reflecting the teachings of Islam.
data.etymology: Aadab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Respect, Courtesy, Honor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadab total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: أدب
in_arabic.meaning: الادب و الفضائل و الجمال و الحسنى
in_arabic.long_meaning: الادب هو فضيلة إسلامية تُشير إلى المعادلة بين الخير والجمال، ويُعتبر أدباً الشخص الذي له أخلاق نزيهة وجمالية، كما يُعد أدباً من يمتلك قدرة كبيرة على التعبير عن نفسه وجماله. وعادة ما يتضمن الأديب قدرة كبيرة على العبارة الدقيقة والجميلة، كما أنهم يتمتعون بشخصية ناضجة ومثقفين. وتأتي كلمة الأديب من الجذر (دب) الذي يعني التخلق والجمال، وهو ما تجلى في قوله تعالى: (وَهَذَا كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَكَ هُدىً وَذِكْرَى إِلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ) [الانبياء: 10].

in_english.name: Aadab
in_english.meaning: Islamic values and good behavior and beauty
in_english.long_meaning: Aadab is an Islamic value that implies the balance between good behavior and beauty. A person who has good behavior and beauty is considered to be an aadab. Aadab people have the ability to express themselves and their beauty in a nice and beautiful way. They have the capacity to convey their thoughts and feelings in a clear and precise manner. Aadab is a value that has been emphasized in the Quran, and it is considered to be an important part of Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: Aadab is a term deeply integrated into Muslim culture that encompasses manners, etiquette, and good behavior. It is a reminder of the importance of respecting and treating others with kindness, whether it is in personal interactions, social customs, or religious practices. The habit of practicing Aadab is fundamental in maintaining harmonious relationships within communities and contributing to a well-mannered and civil society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Aadab signifies acknowledging the presence and worthiness of Allah (God) and His creation. By treating others with respect and kindness, we are reflecting the divine qualities of mercy, compassion, and patience. With a humble and courteous attitude, we can strengthen our bond with Allah, as He values those who are humble and respectful in their behavior. Additionally, practicing Aadab can help prevent conflicts and ease tensions between individuals and communities, promoting peace and unity. Overall, Aadab represents the principles of emulating the divine character in practical everyday living.
